title: Bundled SDK + API Launch: Streaming + Function-Call with Structured Schema Registry
creator: Amira Patel
description:
Goal: Coordinate a combined launch of SDK surface and Redwood API features that introduce streaming responses + function-calling primitives alongside a first-cut structured-output schema registry. This ticket covers cross-team GTM tasks: docs, sample kits, release notes, telemetry gating, and staged rollout matrices.

Scope:
- SDKs (js/py/go) ship: streaming client helpers, function-calling fixtures, and schema-validated serializers.
- API: stable streaming endpoints and function-calling parameters for hosted and dedicated.
- Structured Schema Registry: initial v1 registry for customer-defined output shapes (JSON Schema derived), server-side validation toggle.
- Docs & Samples: quickstarts, localized snippets (EN/DE/FR), runnable sample apps for Slack bot and support ticket summarizer.
- Observability: telemetry events for streaming session starts/ends, function-call latencies, schema-validation failures; sample dashboards in Console.
- Rollout: canary to 5% (internal partners) -> 25% (beta customers) -> GA with deprecation notes for legacy endpoints.

Success Criteria:
- All three SDKs publish SDK docs + sample apps and pass integration smoke tests.
- Streaming + function-call API passes latency SLOs on dedicated infra and has fallback policies in place.
- Schema Registry v1 manageable through Console and can be toggled per-route.
- Release notes, migration guide, and sample migration PRs published at GA.

Out of scope: client-side UI components (handled by design follow-ups), deep localization beyond trio languages, long-term registry UI enhancements (post-launch).
